title: Small CL Field Underwriter
description:
For more than 170 years, The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.
Our Small Commercial Underwriting department is currently seeking a New Business Underwriter to join our team. This is a full time, exempt role. This role is eligible for a hybrid or fully remote arrangement.
POSITION OVERVIEW:
Field Underwriters are responsible for driving the growth of Small CL business by underwriting new business across all lines and sizes of POS and Non-POS accounts, within Small CL definition, and building and maintaining strong agency relationships, partnering with Agency staff and SCSMs. The Field UW should work closely with and direct the activities of their UT partner(s), following established workflows, to ensure all policies are underwritten in the most efficient and effective manner while meeting service standards and performance goals, up through first renewal.
IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

• Lead the daily triage of new business with UT, including POS business.

• Assess submissions, categorize, and direct UT on next steps to be taken based on assessment and categorization.

• Provide direction and guidance to UT to properly prepare a new business account including Quick Declines and how to communicate with Agent (ex. Declination letter or phone call)

• Collect additional information needed for underwriting analysis.

• Interact with the agency to gather needed information in an organized manner.

• Order and analyze necessary reports to perform underwriting analysis.

• Provide accurate instructions to rating.

• Prepare and deliver quote proposals to agents. Also, follow up with agents on open quotes.

• Document underwriting decisions within standards and expectations in Underwriting systems, including ARF and CAAMS.

• Ensure all submissions are effectively managed to reach decline or quoting status.

• Determine the pricing, coverages, including coverage advantages to highlight in the quoting process, account rounding opportunity, and identify cross-sell opportunity for Specialty businesses on accounts being quoted.

• Refer accounts as appropriate if additional authority is required.

• Own all aspects of the New Business underwriting process including acceptability and documentation at inception as well as subsequent validation through other sources including Loss Control.

• Underwriter is responsible for reviewing and responding to back-end underwriting reviews and new business audits. After these steps, the account responsibility falls to the Portfolio underwriter, although consultation between Field and Portfolio Underwriter is expected as required.

• Clearly communicate appetite, declination reasons and coverage advantages to Agents to improve hit ratio.

• Leverage relationships with Agents and SCSMS to identify opportunities to help write business.

• Communicate proactively with agents to convey a sense of ownership and service during all interactions; instill confidence with agents in their decision to place new business with The Hanover.

• Engage in agency travel as needed to build and maintain strong relationships.

• Partner with internal colleagues, mainly SCSMs, UTs and Renewal UW colleagues, to most effectively communicate difficult messages with agent partners and on overall agency management.

KEY MEASURES OF SUCCESS:

• New Business production (approx. $2 Million annually)

• UW profitability based on quality of referrals, quality of audits/ file reviews, and achievement of mix goals

• Service metrics, aligned with workflows

• Agency relationships - as measured by agency feedback

• Hit and Yield ratios

• LOB and class mix targets

Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.
If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.
Why this role, why now
Tyk spent a decade becoming essential infrastructure for some of the world's biggest companies. We're now doing the same thing for the AI era - and we want someone to help us move marketing through that shift. It's a rare moment: a profitable, established company moving fast into new territory, with a small enough team that you'll shape the direction, not just execute it.
Requirements

This is a doing role. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end - planning them and then executing them yourself, with AI as a force multiplier.

•
Own campaigns and launches end-to-end . Write the brief, build the assets and copy, ship the campaign or launch, and report on how it did - you don’t hand any part of that off to someone else or an agency.

•
Run events from first invite to final follow-up. Own the details of owned, sponsored and community events - logistics, outreach, on-the-day readiness, and the follow-up sequence that turns attendees into pipeline.

•

•
Keep GTM moving across Marketing, Sales and Product. Chase the people, approvals and information you need across teams so initiatives don’t stall, and make sure what you ship lands with real commercial impact, not just activity.

•

Here’s what we’re looking for:

•
2-3 years’ experience as a marketing manager, growth marketer or similar - background matters less than what you’ve built and how you think. B2B SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement; agency background is welcome, especially if you’ve built things from scratch for multiple clients.

•
A builder, not just a contributor. You’ve made something from scratch - a campaign, a launch, a side project, a small business - and you can point to it and say “I built that.”

- 5+ years of experience in internal audit, SOX/internal controls, or a related risk/compliance function, including experience managing or mentoring others

- Demonstrated experience building or significantly enhancing a controls program or testing methodology from scratch

- Strong track record managing external audit and/or co-source relationships

- Hands-on experience performing and overseeing walkthroughs, testing, and deficiency evaluation

- Proficiency with Auditboard, Vanta, NetSuite, Google Docs/Workspace, major LLM providers (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), Salesforce, and Workday

title: Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer - Isotopes
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer to join our isotope engineering team to own the thermal hydraulic safety case for the next generation of domestic isotope production facilities.

Position Description

The Thermal-Hydraulics and Safety Analysis Engineer is responsible for developing and executing systems-level thermal-hydraulic analyses that support the safety case, design basis, and licensing of Oklo's reactor systems. This engineer will evaluate reactor and plant response during normal operation, anticipated operational occurrences, and postulated accident conditions using codes such as RELAP5 and other systems-analysis tools.

This role combines hands-on transient modeling with safety-methodology development. The engineer will establish modeling approaches, assess code and model applicability, quantify uncertainty, and produce clear, auditable technical documentation suitable for licensing applications and regulatory review. The engineer will work closely with safety, licensing, reactor physics, thermal-hydraulics, controls, and system-design teams to connect analysis assumptions and acceptance criteria to an evolving reactor design.

This position is focused on thermal-hydraulic safety analysis and licensing support. It does not own source-term, radiological-consequence, or severe-accident progression analysis, although collaboration with engineers performing those analyses may be required.

The isotope engineering team is a small but growing team, so the candidate must be capable of operating in a highly iterative and independent environment.

Specific responsibilities may include:

•
Develop, maintain, and execute systems-level thermal-hydraulic models of reactor and plant behavior using RELAP5 or comparable analysis codes.

•
Analyze normal operating conditions, anticipated operational occurrences, design-basis events, and selected beyond-design-basis conditions relevant to the thermal-hydraulic safety case.

•
Develop event-specific analysis plans, including initial and boundary conditions, assumptions, acceptance criteria, figures of merit, and treatment of uncertainties.

•
Develop and document thermal-hydraulic safety-analysis methods, modeling guidance, and engineering practices appropriate to advanced reactor licensing.

•
Establish and justify code, model, and correlation applicability for the physical phenomena and operating regimes being evaluated.

•
Perform model verification, validation, sensitivity studies, uncertainty analyses, scaling evaluations, and comparisons with experiments, benchmarks, hand calculations, or higher-fidelity analyses. Identify gaps in available methods, data, and validation evidence, and define practical plans to close those gaps.

•
Translate regulatory requirements and safety acceptance criteria into defensible analysis requirements and technical evaluation strategies.

•
Prepare high-quality calculation packages, methodology documents, safety-analysis reports, licensing-application content, and responses to regulator questions.

•
Evaluate design changes and provide timely feedback on their effects on transient response, safety margins, system performance, and the licensing basis.

•
Collaborate with reactor physics, fuel, controls, mechanical, thermal-hydraulics, safety, and licensing engineers on coupled analyses and interface conditions.

•
Develop scripts and automated workflows for model generation, execution, post-processing, regression testing, and configuration control.

•
Review safety analyses and models prepared by internal contributors, vendors, and external partners.

Minimum Qualifications:

•
Bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree in nuclear, mechanical, chemical, or aerospace engineering, or a closely related technical field.

•
Five or more years of relevant experience in reactor thermal-hydraulics, nuclear safety analysis, reactor transient analysis, or a closely related field. A relev

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's global privacy program is scaling rapidly alongside the growth of its e-commerce, advertising, health, and AI-driven product lines, and the regulatory landscape is evolving faster than ever. This role exists to embed privacy into how Instacart builds and operates, ensuring product, engineering, data science, advertising, health, and business development teams have clear, practical guidance as they move quickly. Without this partnership, cross-functional teams lack the legal support needed to navigate complex data governance decisions, from adtech and retail data sharing to AI product development. • Privacy program operations are strengthened: PRAs and DPIAs are supported, intake and documentation processes run effectively, and standard guidance, templates, playbooks, and training materials make privacy requirements accessible and scalable across the organization.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• 6+ years of experience focused on privacy and data protection, at a leading law firm, in-house, or both

• Deep working knowledge of CCPA, GDPR, HIPAA, and the evolving landscape of U.S. state privacy and health data laws

• Experience advising on adtech, data sharing, and consumer data use in a retail, e-commerce, or platform environment

• Strong ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance for non-legal stakeholders

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with AI governance and privacy-by-design in ML/AI product development

• Experience in AdTech

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

You will participate in stakeholder engagements, setting critical requirements, problem definition, and the development and execution of algorithms and solutions to the problems.

• To apply machine learning and related technologies for social good, you will need to understand user challenges and their context, curate and transform data, train and validate models, create evaluations and benchmarks, run simulations, and broadly derive insights from data. • You will be encouraged to drive fundamental advances to the technology domains themselves as part of the efforts towards their application, present your work in technical and other forums of interest, and publish in leading conferences and journals.

• Excellence as an individual contributor goes together with good teamwork and collaboration. You will mentor junior researchers, post-docs, and interns, and participate in recruiting and hiring activities. You will also be expected to interact with external partners when required, and to make periodic visits to the communities from where challenges are derived and where the solutions will be deployed.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Economics or a relevant quantitative field with relevant work experience of 6+ years OR a Master’s degree in these fields with 4+ years of relevant experience OR a Ph.D. in Machine Learning with a focus on LLMs from a reputed institute.

• We are looking for ML Scientists with experience applying AI, machine learning, and data science to real-world problems. Ideal candidates should also have a strong research background, have experience in mentoring junior researchers through strong code practices and ideation, and be adept at a variety of data mining/analysis methods and tools, building and implementing models, visualising data, creating/using algorithms, and running simulations. title: Program Manager Cards
description:
Program Manager - Cards

Location: Belgium - Brussels

About Capco

Capco is a global business and technology consultancy specializing in financial services. We help leading financial institutions navigate complex change, improve their operations and deliver transformation across business and technology. Our collaborative and entrepreneurial environment gives you the opportunity to develop your expertise and contribute to projects with a tangible impact.

About the Team

You will join Capco's financial services consulting team and work with business leaders, technology teams and external partners on a major cards program. The assignment involves close collaboration across an international banking group, bringing together stakeholders with different priorities to deliver a coordinated program.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead the business delivery of a complex cards program. You will take ownership of program planning, governance and delivery, ensuring that objectives, resources, budgets and dependencies remain aligned.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders, group-level teams and an external service provider. The role calls for someone who can combine a strategic view with disciplined execution, make informed decisions and maintain momentum across multiple projects and teams.

This is a hybrid role based in Brussels, with regular travel to Paris for program and stakeholder meetings.

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain integrated program plans, aligning milestones, dependencies and delivery priorities across workstreams.

• Establish and manage program governance, including decision-making, escalation and reporting processes.

• Prepare and lead program boards and steering committees, presenting progress, risks and decisions clearly.

• Manage relationships with business and IT stakeholders, international group teams and external suppliers.

• Monitor delivery against scope, timelines and objectives, and coordinate actions to address delays or changing priorities.

• Identify and manage risks, issues and cross-project dependencies.

• Coordinate capacity planning and resource allocation across the program.

• Manage program budgets and business cases, monitoring financial performance and supporting investment decisions.

• Lead and motivate contributors, maintaining clear accountability and a shared focus on outcomes.

What You Will Bring

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including proven responsibility for complex projects or programs involving multiple workstreams.

• A strong understanding of banking operations and the ability to connect business objectives with technology delivery.

• Experience working across business and IT teams, with familiarity with enterprise IT systems and workflow processes.

• Strong knowledge of project and program management methodologies, such as Agile, PRINCE2 or PMBOK, and relevant planning and reporting tools such as Clarity or MS Project.

• Experience managing governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, resources, risks and delivery dependencies.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the diplomacy and confidence to align different interests and drive decisions.

• A structured, proactive and results-oriented approach, combined with strategic thinking, commercial awareness and a focus on customer outcomes.

• A master's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in the cards business, including card issuing or processing systems, is a strong advantage. Previous work with BNP Paribas or eWL, or on initiatives that centralize activities onto shared platforms within an international group, is also valuable.

Languages

• Strong written and spoken English, plus professional proficiency in either French or Dutch, is required.

• Knowledge of both French and Dutch is an advantage.

Why Join Capco?

Join an international consultancy where you can lead complex transformation programs

Rôle du coopérant-volontaire
Notre partenaire L'ANPE souhaite renforcer la visibilité et l'attractivité de sa plateforme dédiée au volontariat afin de promouvoir davantage les opportunités d'engagement citoyen et de valoriser l'impact des volontaires sur le développement socioéconomique du pays.
À travers cette mission virtuelle, le ou la coopérant(e)-volontaire apportera son expertise en communication numérique, en marketing de contenu et en storytelling afin de rendre la plateforme plus dynamique, engageante et accessible. La personne retenue contribuera également à transformer les réalisations et expériences des volontaires en récits inspirants capables de mobiliser de nouveaux partenaires, volontaires et parties prenantes.
Le/la coopérant(e)-volontaire devra mener les activités suivantes :

• Contribuer à l'animation et à l'amélioration de la plateforme dédiée au volontariat

• Proposer de nouvelles rubriques et approches de contenu afin d'en accroître l'attractivité et la visibilité

• Appuyer la création et la diffusion de contenus numériques adaptés aux différents publics cibles

• Recueillir, analyser et valoriser les expériences et réalisations des volontaires

• Rédiger des témoignages, portraits, articles et récits d'impact mettant en lumière les contributions des volontaires

Compétences académiques essentielles :

• Diplôme universitaire en communication, journalisme, marketing, design graphique, médias numériques ou dans tout autre domaine pertinent
Compétences professionnelles essentielles :

• Minimum de deux (2) années d'expérience en communication ou dans un domaine connexe

• Expérience en communication web, rédaction de contenu ou gestion de plateformes numériques

• Bonne connaissance des techniques de storytelling et de création de contenu engageant

À propos du coopérant-volontaire
Le programme de volontariat virtuel de Cuso International accueille de nouveaux et anciens bénévoles à travailler à distance avec nos partenaires internationaux et bureaux pays. Le volontariat virtuel offre plusieurs des avantages du volontariat international, cependant se démarque pour sa flexibilité; pouvant être géré à partir de chez soi et en accord avec sa disponibilité. You'll own the modelling and analysis roadmap for the FX product and turn rigorous statistical and machine learning work into better trading, product and commercial decisions.

- Own and drive the technical direction and modelling roadmap for the FX product, identifying high-impact opportunities and prioritising work in collaboration with Product Managers.

You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week.

- 7+ years of industry experience and an advanced degree, such as a PhD or MS, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, Computer Science or Economics.

- Significant experience applying statistics, machine learning or optimisation to financial markets, trading, fintech or other dynamic decision systems.

- Strong understanding of FX, execution, pricing, liquidity, market risk or related quantitative domains.

- Expert Python skills and strong SQL skills; experience with R or other quantitative tools is a plus.

- Strong foundations in time-series modelling, statistical inference, optimisation and experimental design.

- Ability to do schema design and dimensional data modelling, taking models from research/prototyping into reliable production systems.

- Proven ability to set direction, influence and communicate with senior stakeholders and deliver through cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED

- Experience in technology, financial services, a trading environment and/or a high-growth environment.

- You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

- You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Summary:
Your day as a Construction Manager will be a mix of communication, collaboration, and problem-solving as you oversee all aspects of multiple construction projects from inception to completion. You’ll start by reviewing project updates and progress reports, ensuring Key Performance Indicators like safety, quality, cost, and schedule are on track. A large part of your day will be spent engaging with stakeholders-including internal Sr Leaders and Operations, contractors, engineers, architects, vendors, and regulatory bodies-providing clear and concise updates while facilitating effective decision-making.

Primary Accountabilities:

• All aspects of construction projects, from project inception to final completion.

• Provide timely, concise, and transparent communications to operations and all stakeholders.

• Direct general contractors, engineers, architects, and vendors to complete construction projects while satisfying contract requirements.

• Ensure that vendors deliver work to meet duration and quality targets, addressing and ensuring the correction of under-performance issues.

• Accountable to minimize, record and oversee completion of all project deficiencies in a timely manner.

• Cultivate a culture of safety in accordance with department guidelines.

• Hand over projects to stakeholders after successful completion of commissioning protocols.

• The role is remote and will include upwards of 50% travel regionally, with the potential of traveling to all North America locations based on the business needs

• Operational experience in c-store, fueling, or quick service restaurant

• Understanding of accessibility and life safety laws and how they apply

• Expertise in installing and maintaining retail (UST) fueling systems

• Working knowledge of refrigeration equipment, electrical, plumbing and HVAC systems

• Additional certifications or education applicable to this role

Key Qualifications

• Construction and project management experience

• Bachelor's Degree

• Alternatively: High School diploma/GED with equivalent experience or 4 + years of US military experience

description:
About Foodsmart:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.
Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members-including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers-on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.
Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. title: Fullstack Engineer (Moderation)
description:
ABOUT STREAM

Stream powers real-time Chat https://getstream.io/chat/, Video https://getstream.io/video/, Activity Feeds https://getstream.io/activity-feeds/, and AI Moderation https://getstream.io/moderation/ for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer I to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the backend of our AI Moderation product: building new capabilities and making the Go services behind them cleaner, faster and more reliable.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Toronto co-working space.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

You'll join our five-person Moderation team, which builds the product customers use to detect, review and act on harmful content in their apps. The role leans backend. Dedicated frontend engineers own the moderation dashboards, and you'll own the Go services, data model and integrations behind them, stepping into React when a feature spans the stack. You'll work closely with the team lead, our other Toronto-based engineer, Infrastructure, and the Customer Success and Support teams, and directly with customers' trust and safety and engineering teams.

Here's the honest current state: the product has grown fast and the backend has grown with it. There's real cleanup, refactoring and simplification to do, and you'll have the room to do it well. You'll also give the team coverage in North American hours, which today rests largely on one engineer.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Build new moderation features: design and ship Go services from database schema and API endpoints through to production rollout, including work on our new AI moderation flow.

- Clean up the backend: refactor existing moderation services, reduce technical debt, simplify code paths and raise test coverage.

- Improve reliability and performance: strengthen alerting and observability, and fix scaling and latency issues in the moderation pipeline.

- Own third-party integrations: maintain and extend the AI and moderation providers that plug into the pipeline.

- Keep production healthy: diagnose defects to root cause and take part in on-call, with a focus on North American hours.

- Work with customers: troubleshoot their issues directly and bring what you learn back into the roadmap.

- Work across the stack when needed: ship React changes alongside the frontend engineers and review your peers' code.

ABOUT YOU

You're a backend engineer at heart who is comfortable picking up frontend work when a feature needs it. You enjoy leaving a codebase better than you found it, and you'd rather simplify a service than add another layer to it. You like owning problems end to end, including the ones that show up in production or in a customer conversation.

You probably won't enjoy this role if you want a pure frontend position, a large team with a fixed process, or a job with no on-call. The team is small, the product is moving fast, and North American coverage is part of the job.

YOU HAVE:

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, mostly on the backend.

- Solid backend experience in Go, Python or a comparable language, and willingness to work in Go. We run a 10-week internal Go onboarding programme.

- Experience designing REST APIs and relational data models (ideally Postgres), and working with Redis.

- A track record of shipping features used at scale and of refactoring and improving existing production systems.

- Working knowledge of React and TypeScript or JavaScript.

- Experience with automated testing across client and server code.

- Comfort working with customers and handling production incidents.
